_readme: The reply text that each provider's stored agent row holds, as the browser's transcript shows it.

Two implementations replay this file: agenttest.RunReplyTextConformance, which the package of each provider in backend/internal/worker/agent/providers runs over its own cases through agent.ReplyText, and frontend/src/components/chat/replyTextConformance.test.ts, which replays every case through prepareChatRow.

A case states the row that the Worker stores: `content` is the decoded content, `supplemental` the decoded rendering supplement, `agent_session_id` the session that the row belongs to, and `assembled_kind` the column that the Worker derives from an assembled envelope.

`reply` is the quotable text of the assistant-text row that the browser extracts (quotableTextForRow: the text without the white space at either end), or null for a row that holds no reply: another kind of row, or an assistant text of white space only.
Each provider has a case with a reply and a case without one. `leapmux control agent send --wait` prints this text.
